# anypoint_managed_omni_gateways (Data Source)

Lists all `managed omni gateway` instances in an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anypoint_managed_omni_gateways" "gateways" {
  organization_id = var.root_org
  environment_id  = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment id where the gateways are deployed.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization id where the gateways are deployed.

### Read-Only

- `gateways` (List of Object) The list of managed omni gateway instances. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `release_channel` (String)
- `runtime_version` (String)
- `size` (String)
- `status` (String)
